summary: The staged help site is served by nginx on TCP 8080. Legacy /manual URLs permanently redirect to matching /help URLs with paths and query strings preserved. /status.txt remains directly accessible. Configuration survived the required node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the Ubuntu-compatible nginx package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured nginx to serve /srv/legacy2/permanent-url-migration on port 8080.
Added HTTP 301 redirects from /manual and /manual/* to corresponding /help URLs.
Enabled nginx at boot and restarted node1 exactly once.
Verified source content, redirects, query preservation, boot identity change, and post-restart recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: nginx listens on IPv4/IPv6 port 8080; help documents return HTTP 200 and match their staged source files before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Permanently redirect old manual URLs while retaining path and query string
evidence.summary: Both /manual and nested URLs return HTTP 301. The nested path and full query string are preserved, and following the redirect returns the matching help document.
/status.txt returns HTTP 200 directly and its response body matches the supplied status document before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID bdd5de93-e94e-4d33-8384-6a01c51a3d49, acknowledged a native scheduled reboot, then observed boot ID 7f038c12-0c64-47c8-9d6e-dd3ed6b5aa5d with nginx active/enabled and all content and redirect checks recovered.
